items.title: Wendy Oxenhorn interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, January 22, 2026
items.q: I just loved blues and Billie Holiday, Frank Sinatra kind of jazz.

ctx.x: You know I had written down a couple and you had two that I wrote down, because I was just trying to put myself in your position. Was there ever melancholy involved?

The melancholy came from two sources. One, how I even got the position and what I had been doing before that actually caused them to stand up and shake my hand at the job interview and say, “You’re it.” I had an interesting introduction to jazz. From the time I was a little kid I loved blues. I just loved blues and Billie Holiday, Frank Sinatra kind of jazz. And I used to listen with a transistor radio and swing on the swings and sing my heart out. You know. My biggest wish when I was like ten was to be a…
even though I was a classical ballerina I grew up watching “Soul Train” on Saturdays trying to learn to dance like that you know. But anyway – it’s just –
